annotations.title: 個人事業主の届け出・申告・納付の期限の目安

description: List the usual deadlines for a sole proprietor in Japan for one year, from National Tax Agency pages: the opening notice (開業届, due by the income-tax return deadline of the opening year), the blue-return application (青色申告承認申請: March 15, or within 2 months of opening when the business started on or after January 16), the income-tax return (March 15 of the next year), the consumption-tax return for individuals (March 31), the two estimated-tax installments (予定納税: July 31, November 30) and the special withholding-tax payment dates (納期の特例: July 10, January 20). Each date is moved to the next day when it falls on a weekend, national holiday, December 29–31 or January 1–3 (国税通則法 第10条第2項). Give the year and/or the opening date; each item says when it applies, and the caller decides which apply. For a business opened before 2026-01-01 the opening-notice deadline is not given (the article changed on that day). Years are accepted up to one year before the end of the holiday data.
